chapter: Cab Calloway, Lunceford, Hampton and Armstrong, 1941-45
title: Joining Lionel Hampton's band
summary: McRae, who replaced Dexter Gordon, stayed with Hampton for almost three years.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money

blocks.x: And I think after that, Hamp wanted me to go on --

Hamp wanted me to go back something like that on the road with again, (inaudible).
Okay. This is 1943. This was, say, the first call from Hamp -- from Lionel Hampton?
Well -- No, this must've been because -- I probably didn't stay with Hamp -- I stayed with Hamp about a year or two, because in '44 I had left Hamp in Pittsburgh.
That's when I -- I left Hamp in Pittsburgh. We had travelled all through out the Midwest. We did like -- we had played Loew's State Theater that (inaudible) time.
I went to Boston to join Hamp. I was supposed to come back and go with Les Brown. But I stayed with Hamp because he asked Joe to let me stay because he needed a tenor player.
And Dexter left him after that date in the club.up there.
